title: Automatic Debit of Monthly Payments: Rural Home Loans Member Terms
content:
**Terms.** Automatic debit of Rural Home Loans monthly payments is authorised, moved or cancelled only on the member's own instruction, the account identified by the last four digits the member gives, recorded exactly as given. Autopay may be changed only while the loan is in active, forbearance or nonaccrual status. The full monthly payment is debited on the due date. Cancelling autopay that was set up at closing removes the closing autopay discount under the note rate setting rule; moving the debit to another account keeps it.

## Who may instruct, and what is recorded

| Point | Term |
|---|---|
| Instruction | the member's own |
| Account | identified by the last four digits the member gives |
| Recording | exactly as given |
| Amount debited | the full monthly payment, on the due date |

## Status check

The loan's status is read from the loan record before the change: active, forbearance or nonaccrual allow a change; applied, paid off and declined do not.

## Effect of each instruction on the closing autopay discount

| Instruction | Closing autopay discount |
|---|---|
| Cancel autopay set up at closing | removed |
| Move the debit to another account | kept |
| Authorise autopay | — |
